BR-56

BRAKE SYSTEM — Anti-lock Brake System (A.B.S.)

Continued from BR-55

Is connector of computer properly connected?
And are all terminals in the connector?

NO → Faulty connector.

YES
↓

Is there 10 — 16 V between terminal IG on
computer wire harness side connector and
body ground? (Ignition switch on)

NO → Faulty power circuit.

YES
↓

Does warning light go off when both the
computer connector and actuator check con-
nector are disconnected? (Ignition switch on)

NO
(Comes on) → Short circuit in wire harness between
computer terminal W and actuator
terminal W.

YES
(Goes off)
↓

Faulty computer.
